assets.name: tangting
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: Mount Tangting scene for an existing Chinese Shanhaijing reading website. Generate one landscape woodcut vignette on a genuinely transparent background. Subject: a quiet wooded mountain with several leafy yan trees, two small white apes sitting naturally among the trees, modest hints of clear quartz and ochre mineral veins in rocks. Scene is an artistic illustration, not a real geographic reconstruction. Style: fine carved black charcoal knife marks, warm ivory pigment within the illustrated forms, restrained ochre and muted celadon accents, antique Chinese printed-book woodcut, matching a warm parchment atlas. Wide horizontal composition, ample clear space, softly broken irregular carved edges fading into real transparency. No buildings, modern objects, labels, letters, text, seals, arrows, watermarks, checkerboard or opaque rectangular paper background. The white apes have ordinary ape anatomy; no fantasy horns, tails or wings. Avoid photorealism and glossy digital painting.
assets.review_note: Scenic woodcut with white apes and mineral hints; tree form, placement and rock shape are artistic interpretations.
